newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank sets repo rate unchanged 4.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank sets repo rate unchanged 4.10 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, set its weekly reverse repurchase operation on Tuesday at a fixed, unchanged rate of 4.10 percent.
The operation will run from February 5 to 12.
All primary dealers are invited to leave bids with the Riksbank by 0900 GMT on February 4 at the latest.
The lowest accepted volume was 200 million crowns ($27.4 million), while the highest accepted volume was 40 billion crowns, the Riksbank said.
The Riksbank's decision to keep the repo rate unchanged was in line with market expectations. In a Reuters poll of ten economists, all had forecasted an unchanged repo rate.
